description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “HP 124 Condo” at High Pointe Resort, located in Seacrest Beach. Your dream getaway starts here—a cozy 2-bedroom retreat for up to 6 guests. Wake up to poolside serenity, stroll to the private beach, and soak in exclusive resort vibes. First-floor ease means you're steps from vibrant shops, dining, and fun. Whether it’s a lazy beach day or a night out, this spot has it all. Ready to escape to paradise? Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Poolside Patio With Lagoon-Style Pool Just Steps Away – Relax and unwind by the serene community pool, perfect for sun-soaked afternoons and refreshing dips just outside your doorExclusive Private Beach Access For High Pointe Guests – Enjoy the luxury of a private beach escape, where soft sands and tranquil waves await just for youResort Amenities Including Pickleball, Tennis, And Crabby Steve’s Gulf-Front Bar – Stay active with fun-filled games or soak in the laid-back coastal vibe at the iconic Crabby Steve’s with stunning Gulf viewsSeacrest Beach Location Near Rosemary Beach And Local Shopping – Immerse yourself in a charming beachside community, with boutique shops, cozy cafes, and picturesque streets just moments awayEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Absolutely perfect! The location and property were outstanding. The condo was spotless, well-maintained, and just steps away from everything we needed!" – Aida⭐“The pool was incredible, and getting to the beach was a breeze! Our kids had the best time—great for families!" – Victoria⭐"We loved the convenience of the first-floor location! It made everything so much easier, especially with kids. Highly recommend for families!" – Carla*** LIVING AREA ***Bright and beachy, the living space features serene hues and stylish coastal décor. The open floor plan flows seamlessly between the living area, dining room, and outdoor patio. Large glass windows frame the sparkling pool just beyond your door, inviting you to relax and enjoy the tropical ambiance.Luxurious, plush seating paired with a flat-screen TV and premium stereo system for ultimate entertainmentStunning floor-to-ceiling windows offering breathtaking views of the poolSeamless direct access to a spacious outdoor patio with a coffee table for 4, perfect for relaxation or entertaining*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to whip up delicious family meals or quick beachside snacks with ease. Enjoy dining indoors in a cozy setting, or step out onto the patio to savor alfresco meals by the sparkling pool, creating unforgettable moments under the sun or stars.Fully equipped kitchen with a modern stove, oven, spacious refrigerator, and high-efficiency dishwasherStylish counter seating for 3 and a dining table that comfortably seats 6Convenient washer and dryer neatly tucked away in a dedicated laundry alcove*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ***This modern and stylish condo offers the perfect getaway, comfortably accommodating up to 6 guests. It features two spacious, beautifully designed bedrooms that combine elegance and comfort, providing an ideal space for relaxation and rejuvenation.Primary King Suite: Luxurious King-size bed with a private En-suite boasting a double-sink vanity, spacious walk-in closet, and a relaxing tub/shower combo—perfect for unwinding after a long day.Queen Guest Suite: Two comfortable Queen beds with shared access to a beautifully appointed full guest bathroom, featuring a sleek single vanity and a convenient tub/shower combo.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***High Pointe Resort offers an unparalleled coastal escape, combining luxury, relaxation, and adventure. Enjoy world-class amenities, including a stunning lagoon-style waterfall pool that invites you to unwind in style. With direct beach access, you can stroll along pristine sands or take in breathtaking ocean views. Cap off your day with handcrafted cocktails and fresh seafood at the iconic Crabby Steve’s. At High Pointe Resort, every moment is designed to be unforgettable.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a Large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***Nestled in the heart of Seacrest Beach, High Pointe Resort perfectly captures the charm and allure of 30A. Just a short stroll from your condo, you’ll find the vibrant Peddler’s Pavilion, filled with unique local shops, delicious dining options, and lively entertainment. Plus, the stunning shores of neighboring Rosemary and Alys Beaches are right at your fingertips, offering endless opportunities for relaxation and adventure.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 206502
